item.title: Europe Is the Real Growth-Point of Resistance
item.description: As America retreats from its role as guarantor of the free world, the decisive force standing against both Putinism and Trumpism is neither China nor a revived NATO but Europe itself — and the popular charge that Europe "never came to Ukraine's war" collapses the moment you examine it honestly.

item.title: The Crack in the Wall: Why Revolutions Need an Elite Split
item.description: The comforting belief is that a big enough, brave enough crowd would bring this regime down. It would not. A consolidated dictatorship is toppled only when a crack opens in the elite and part of the armed apparatus refuses to shoot — and understanding why is the difference between hope and self-deception.
